query: I have a rough idea for a contractor scheduling SaaS. I want a dry run of the project chain first: product spec, architecture, task plan, repo bootstrap gate, and what approvals you would need before touching files.
Start a brand new local app called invoice-nudge from scratch. Use Python/FastAPI and Postgres, create the planning pack first, and stop before installing packages or initializing git.
Can you turn this product idea into a spec-to-repo workflow? It is a small inventory tracker for our warehouse team, and I need the route, artifacts, validation plan, and release-prep gates.
Use an approval-gated SDLC chain for a new analytics dashboard. I need constitution, backlog, acceptance criteria, architecture, tasks, and a safe bootstrap plan under ./analytics-dashboard.
we need an MVP bootstrap for a greenfield CRM. please separate assumptions from confirmed requirements and tell me where project memory versus shared memory would live.
Create a new repository plan for a healthcare appointment tool, but pause on compliance questions before architecture or implementation because I do not know whether HIPAA applies.
I want a local first vertical slice for a new task board app, but only after the product spec, acceptance criteria, architecture, and explicit approval gates are in place.
Help me create a release-ready starter project from a napkin idea. Do not push, publish, deploy, or create remotes; I want a disciplined project genesis workflow.
Build me a planning pack for a new AI document classifier: constitution, product spec, architecture, tasks, traceability, and the safe next step before repository bootstrap.
I have a React project already. Fix the broken login redirect in src/auth/LoginCallback.tsx and add a regression test.
Review this existing repository for architecture problems and risky refactors. Do not create a new project; I only want an audit report.
Generate acceptance criteria for story US-243 about editing a customer address in our existing CRM backlog.

Summarize the architecture.md file in this project and point out unclear diagrams.
Write unit tests for the pricing calculator using the existing Jest setup. Keep all work inside the current repo.
Design a shared-memory taxonomy for all agents so conventions can be reused across projects.
Migrate our existing REST Assured suite from JUnit 4 to JUnit 5 and update the CI report.
